audit_checks.archived_strict_validator: all six reports passed; raw sample identities/counts/elapsed/throughput/nearest-rank percentiles and 480 exact diagnostic archive identities/hashes/deltas validated

notes: Only this completed rerun is analyzed. No sample from vibedb-health-short-6aca5f18 or the earlier structural comparison is included. Root reported the first campaign failed during untimed CREATE; both rerun arms contain the same exact catalog-authority correction, independently checked byte-for-byte.

The wrapper internally labels both VibeDB arms candidate. Authoritative identities are arm, revision and order. Both use three fused physical serving processes, RF3, one SQL entrypoint, identical diagnostics and the same client binary.

All eight actual executables are ELF64 little-endian AArch64. Actual go version -m metadata was reread for all seven VibeDB/client binaries: GOOS=linux, GOARCH=arm64, GOEXPERIMENT=simd, CGO_ENABLED=0 and correct immutable VCS revisions. The darwin/arm64 go version line describes the compiler host, not the benchmark OS. CRDB is its stock Linux ARM64 build; no claim is made that CRDB uses the Go SIMD experiment or that every measured query executes SIMD instructions.
Medians use the two trial summaries within each workload/concurrency/order. Geomeans equally weight ten cells within each order. Orderings are not pooled.

Before-first semantic SQL reads are local for both VibeDB arms (zero SQL-request encodings). After-first semantic SQL reads are remote for both arms (17600 encodings each). Additional local/remote calls include legacy/control work; total call counts must not be interpreted as one call per SQL operation. Update/control locality also differs between arms.

Health revision publication lines are present in all four retained VibeDB logs. Configuration warnings and ineligible-replacement messages also appear. Some before-first configuration warnings occur between update diagnostic snapshots, so they cannot all be dismissed as teardown. Untimestamped retained log text cannot establish a precise causal impact on trial latency.

Zero SQL errors does not mean all runtime diagnostics were error-free. Native connection-service failure counters increased by 6/5 in before-first before/after and 5/2 in after-first before/after. No failed ready waves, native rejections, remote poison/rejection/handshake failures or checkpoint rejections occurred within the trial brackets. Their connection-failure cause is not established by this audit.

All VibeDB checkpoint submission, wait and service counters stayed zero during trial brackets. Barriers are summed across three nodes and may include background work; these counts do not measure fsync latency or checkpoint performance.

This remains one table with 1024 rows, two repetitions, C1/C8 and one Docker host. The scan/group trials contain 200 samples each, limiting p99 resolution. Neither geomean reaches 1.25x, and before-first has two p99 regressions above 10%; this is a separate same-fused health diagnostic, not a completed registered promotion or full 2x CRDB comparison.
conclusion: Health change improves per-order throughput geomeans and update rates, with p99 regressions and controller warnings retained. Both orders remain slower than CRDB. This is a qualified short diagnostic, not a promotion or full-goal completion.

recommended_archive.exclusions: Do not archive source/node manifests, certificates, private keys, supervisor configuration, command logs, binaries or duplicate raw directories. Health log excerpts and platform/build metadata are summarized here; review separately before retaining complete logs.

post_measurement_cleanup.vibedb: All four fixtures exited without forced shutdown, supervisor exit0.
post_measurement_cleanup.qualification: These cleanup events follow measurement and verification; no crash/recovery qualification is claimed.

checkpoint_counter_scope: Zero checkpoint-coordinator counters do not prove absence of snapshots or disk synchronization. The preceding write profile established full SnapshotState health observations on a separate path.
